sn14.11:1.4: ābhādhātu subhādhātu ākāsā nañcāyatanadhātu viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu neva saññānāsaññāyatanadhātu saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu
sn14.11:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn14.11:2.2: yā cāyaṃ bhante ābhādhātu yā ca subhādhātu yā ca ākāsānañcāyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu imā nu kho bhante dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantīti.
sn14.11:3.1: yāyaṃ bhikkhu ābhādhātu ayaṃ dhātu andhakāraṃ paṭicca paññāyati.
sn14.11:3.2: yāyaṃ bhikkhu subhādhātu ayaṃ dhātu asubhaṃ paṭicca paññāyati.
sn14.11:3.3: yāyaṃ bhikkhu ākāsānañcāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu rūpaṃ paṭicca paññāyati.
sn14.11:3.4: yāyaṃ bhikkhu viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ paṭicca paññāyati.
sn14.11:3.5: yāyaṃ bhikkhu ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ paṭicca paññāyati.
sn14.11:3.6: yāyaṃ bhikkhu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ paṭicca paññāyati.
sn14.11:3.7: yāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu ayaṃ dhātu nirodhaṃ paṭicca paññāyatīti.
sn14.11:4.1: yā cāyaṃ bhante ābhādhātu yā ca subhādhātu yā ca ākāsānañcā yatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññā yatanadhātu yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu yā ca saññā vedayitanirodhadhātu imā nu kho bhante dhātuyo kathaṃ samāpatti pattabbāti.
sn14.11:5.1: yā cāyaṃ bhikkhu ābhādhātu yā ca subhādhātu yā ca ākāsānañcāyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu imā dhātuyo saññāsamāpatti pattabbā.
sn14.11:5.2: yāyaṃ bhikkhu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu ayaṃ dhātu saṅkhārāvasesa samāpatti pattabbā.
sn14.11:5.3: yāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu ayaṃ dhātu nirodhasamāpatti pattabbāti.
